newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Hamilton sees A$500,000 year net profit.
newsitem.headline: Hamilton sees A$500,000 year net profit.

text.p: Holiday resort operator Hamilton Island Ltd said on Thursday it expected to report a net profit after abnormals for the year to June 30, 1997 of about A$500,000.
Profit before abnormals would be about A$100,000.
Hamilton managing director Wayne Kirkpatrick said the revised result was disappointing and below previous forecasts.
However, he said it compared with a 1995/96 net loss before abnormals of A$2.1 million and a loss of A$53.6 million after abnormals.
Kirkpatrick said the revised expectations followed the loss of 2,587 room nights in the March quarter due to Cyclone Justin, as well as a softer Japanese tourist market.
Cyclone wind gusts and tidal surges also caused A$880,000 in damage to the resort, off the Queensland coast, although a large part of the damage would be covered by insurance.
Despite the difficulties, Kirkpatrick said improvements at the resort and better marketing should see a continuing pick-up in the company's financial performance.
